name: Niizuma wa Mahou Shoujo
source:
Mai comes to the human world to make 100 people happy and thus become a full-fledged witch. She only has 5 people left! One day she gets spotted and prepares to erase memories as usual, but Koutarou sincerely encourages her instead of behaving creepy, so she does no such thing. Mai helps to solve Koutarou's problems with classmates and teachers, but eventually the bond intensifies, and they start to live as a couple.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
舞来到人类世界，必须让100人感到幸福，才能成为独当一面的魔女。她只差五个人了！一天，她被人发现，正准备像往常一样消除对方记忆；但幸太郎没有表现得诡异，反而真诚地鼓励她，于是她没有这么做。舞帮助幸太郎解决与同学和教师之间的问题，然而两人的羁绊逐渐加深，最后开始以恋人身份共同生活。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
